name: Kasperer
beschreibung: Gasthof Kasperer welcomes visitors in the center of the celebrated festival village of Erl in the lower Inn Valley. This traditional family-run guesthouse charms guests with its cozy alpine parlor and warm, unpretentious hospitality. Well-appointed rooms provide a restful base for cultural attendees and outdoor lovers alike. The kitchen takes pride in serving hearty Tyrolean comfort food, including golden Wiener Schnitzel, savory Tiroler Gröstl, and homemade desserts made from regional produce. Located just moments from the renowned Erl Passion Play House and Festival Hall, it serves as a wonderful cultural and hiking hub.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional inn in Erl in the Kufstein district near the festival halls featuring classic Tyrolean dining.
